message.reasoning:
We need to produce test cases for focal method builder(JsonSchemaFactory). Identify all possible exception scenarios. Look at method builder(JsonSchemaFactory blueprint). It creates a Builder from builder() then adds meta schemas, defaultMetaSchemaURI, objectMapper, yamlMapper, addUriMappings, then loops over blueprint.uriTranslators, adding each, then loops over blueprint.uriFactory.getURIFactories() entries, adding each, then loops over blueprint.uriFetcher.getURIFetchers() entries, adding each. Potential exceptions: blueprint could be null -> NullPointerException when calling blueprint.jsonMetaSchemas etc. Also blueprint.uriTranslators may be null? In class, uriTranslators is a CompositeURITranslator, likely not null. But if blueprint is null, NPE. Also blueprint.jsonMetaSchemas may be null? In JsonSchemaFactory constructor, jsonMetaSchemas is a Map, likely non-null. But if blueprint constructed with null map via reflection? Not typical. However builder method accesses blueprint.jsonMetaSchemas.values() -> NPE if jsonMetaSchemas null. Also blueprint.uriFactory may be null -> NPE when calling getURIFactories(). Similarly uriFetcher null. Also blueprint.uriMap may be null -> addUriMappings expects Map, but passing null may cause NPE. Also blueprint.objectMapper null -> builder.objectMapper(null) allowed? In Builder.build() they treat null as new ObjectMapper, but builder.objectMapper(null) sets field to null, okay. So no exception there. The method returns Builder, not building final factory.

Thus exception scenarios: passing null blueprint => NPE. Passing blueprint with null internal maps (jsonMetaSchemas, uriFactory, uriFetcher, uriMap) causing NPE. Also blueprint with null uriTranslators? But likely not null.

Thus we need test cases for each exception scenario. Provide group names.

We must avoid duplication with existing test cases (they cover normal behavior). So we add new groups for exception scenarios.

Test case format JSON array.

We'll create groups:

- builder(JsonSchemaFactory) - null blueprint
- builder(JsonSchemaFactory) - blueprint with null jsonMetaSchemas map
- builder(JsonSchemaFactory) - blueprint with null uriFactory
- builder(JsonSchemaFactory) - blueprint with null uriFetcher
- builder(JsonSchemaFactory) - blueprint with null uriMap

Each case expects NullPointerException.

Provide description.

Input parameter: blueprint with description.

Ok.

Now output JSON strictly.
